modules.title: What is AI?
modules.blurb: A working mental model: what an LLM actually does, the vocabulary, why data decides everything, and a delegation heuristic you can carry under pressure.

modules.title: Choosing the tool for the task
modules.blurb: Chat assistants, copilots, and the AI already embedded in your HR stack — what each is actually for, and how to tell a language model from a scoring engine before you rely on either.

modules.title: What it costs and how it scales
modules.blurb: Tokens, context windows, and pricing — enough of the economics to size a use case, read a vendor quote, and know when a bigger model is worth it.

modules.title: Working with your documents and data
modules.blurb: Attachments, long documents, and sensitive material: getting your world into the model's view without crowding out the question — or crossing a line your legal team hasn't cleared.

modules.title: Prompting as briefing
modules.blurb: Role, task, context, format. Prompting as briefing a capable stranger — and iteration as the keystone behavior that separates fluent users from frustrated ones.

modules.title: When it's confidently wrong
modules.blurb: Hallucination in depth: why fluent output deserves more scrutiny, not less, and the verification habits that keep a fabricated citation out of a document with someone's name on it.

modules.title: The lines that don't move
modules.blurb: Bias, adverse impact, and decisions about people. Where AI assists, where it must stop, and how to say so in a way your organization will actually follow.

modules.title: What you own
modules.blurb: Data agreements, disclosure, and accountability. What you're responsible for when AI touched the work — and the policy questions to settle before someone asks.

modules.title: From one-offs to workflows
modules.blurb: The workflow lens: five parts every repeatable workflow has, the audit that finds your candidates, the selection rules — and the capstone's first stage: pick your build and spec it.

modules.title: Context that keeps
modules.blurb: The artisan tax and its refund: context packs — what's durable, what arrives fresh, what never becomes infrastructure — built hands-on in your organization's tools.

modules.title: Document pipelines
modules.blurb: Chains with checkpoints: structure forward, prose last, and the lossy middle where detail dies. Your workflow becomes a pipeline and runs on real material.

modules.title: Verification by design
modules.blurb: The verification budget: sized to stakes, matched to failure mode, cheap enough to survive week six — plus the sign-off that means something and the path for when something ships wrong anyway.

modules.title: Handing it to an agent
modules.blurb: The autonomy ladder, priced in evidence: draft-only, propose-then-approve, act-with-audit-trail. Guardrails as permissions, the decision-laundering test, and the refusal as a senior artifact.

modules.title: People data in production
modules.blurb: Four tiers, the person-test, redaction as a pipeline step, the agreement layer, and a blame-safe escalation path. The boundary sheet that makes your workflow deployable.

modules.title: The operating rhythm
modules.blurb: Seconds per run, ten a week, twenty a month. Four honest numbers with a baseline, retirement criteria written in advance — and the reckoning against your Module 1 prediction.

modules.title: Ship it and prove it
modules.blurb: The capstone lands: the consistency pass, the handoff test with a cold reader, and the executive sentence with receipts. Completes the jump to Practitioner.

modules.title: Where you actually are
modules.blurb: Most of the urgency was manufactured: what the adoption data actually says, and the difference between a peer gap and an expectations gap.

modules.title: Sort your own job
modules.blurb: Two questions — presence, contested judgment — and the four quadrants they produce. Least penetrated is not protected.

modules.title: The honest arithmetic
modules.blurb: Botsitting, the four-question workflow audit, the volume trap, and tearing down a claim on evidence, sample, and falsifier.

modules.title: Adversarial rehearsal
modules.blurb: Five adversaries, five sting moves, and the model's job is to attack your work rather than make it. The tutor is the surface.

modules.title: Arguing with finance
modules.blurb: A story loses to a model. Three you can build, the ways your HR data lies, and why small numbers demand the n in the sentence.

modules.title: The line
modules.blurb: The law about systems and the law about your documents: the patchwork, the agent theory, and ER documentation that survives discovery.

modules.title: Manager capability as product
modules.blurb: Catching misuse without driving it underground, what the coaching evidence really says, and why allocating human support is an equity call.

modules.title: What broke
modules.blurb: The two-sided collapse of signal cost, the symmetry rule, and why detection is a screening decision about people.

modules.title: Sorting your own job
modules.blurb: Throughput, insight, redesign — plus the archetype split that reverses every piece of advice.

modules.title: The highest-leverage hour is intake
modules.blurb: Errors here compound and everything downstream inherits them. Four artifacts from one conversation, then get it marked wrong.

modules.title: Designing signal that's expensive to fake
modules.blurb: The corrected selection science, three design moves, and the candidate AI policy where incoherence is the only losing choice.

modules.title: The closed loop
modules.blurb: Instrument, capture, analyze, feed back — and the one asset in recruiting you can't rent.

modules.title: The floor and the audit
modules.blurb: Bias-audit regimes, the agent theory, and computing a selection rate so an audit is a control rather than a document.

modules.title: Arguing for your function
modules.blurb: Workslop lands on the hiring manager, the one-page case, and the headcount conversation with your team and your exec.

modules.title: What this job actually is
modules.blurb: Five work types across comp and benefits, and the finding most practitioners get wrong about their own week — run as a buying instrument.

modules.title: Reading the evidence
modules.blurb: The real adoption picture, the three tells of a product roadmap wearing an industry trend, and the teardown applied to a vendor you pay.

modules.title: The craft layer
modules.blurb: Why numerate people are more exposed, audit files and reconciliation named in advance, the Python-then-Excel double-pass, and a reusable starter kit.

modules.title: The exclusion zone
modules.blurb: AI for speed, human-built tooling for accountability — the four zones, the circular one, and a legal floor that is moving. Counsel review required.

modules.title: The counterparty
modules.blurb: Candidates arrive briefed by a model that gives your two sides different numbers, and your proxy is now read by machines against every peer at once.

modules.title: The bet
modules.blurb: The leverage ladder, why efficiency is the weakest case a small function has, and a bet with a funding line — plus the reckoning against Module 1.

courses.title: AI 101 · Foundations
courses.blurb: From Novice to Practitioner: a working mental model, honest calibration, and the judgment to know what to hand over.

courses.title: AI 201 · The Practitioner
courses.blurb: Workflows that stick: one real build advanced across eight modules. Module 1 is open — designed to follow AI 101, and open to the adventurous either way.

courses.title: AI 301 · The Specialist — HRBP
courses.blurb: Judgment work: the HR business partner's role in depth. AI is improving HR's production, not HR's judgment — this course is about the second thing.

courses.title: AI 301 · The Specialist — Recruiting
courses.blurb: Rebuilding the signal: the cost of producing a credible application collapsed on both sides of the table at once. This course is about building signal that's expensive to fake.

courses.title: AI 301 · The Specialist — Comp & Benefits
courses.blurb: Numbers that hold: you are the most numerate function in HR, and that is exactly what makes fluent output dangerous here. A wrong sentence gets caught. A wrong model gets presented.

courses.title: AI 401 · The Translator
courses.blurb: Leading the multiplayer game: coaching other functions, evaluating vendors, running pilots that produce evidence instead of anecdotes — and owning the policy for what AI may touch.
